String.string:
[EN] Let the game begin.
[ES] Que comience el juego.

[EN] The Bloody Statue activates.
[ES] La estatua sangrienta se activa.

[EN] The Radiant Statue activates.
[ES] La estatua radiante se activa.

[EN] The Cursed Statue activates.
[ES] La estatua maldita se activa.

[EN] The Bloody Statue and Radiant Statue activate.
[ES] La estatua sangrienta y la estatua radiante se activan.

[EN] The Bloody Statue and Cursed Statue activate.
[ES] La estatua sangrienta y la estatua maldita se activan.

[EN] The Radiant Statue and Cursed Statue activate.
[ES] La estatua radiante y la estatua maldita se activan.

[EN] The Bloody Statue appears again.
[ES] La estatua sangrienta aparece de nuevo.

[EN] The Radiant Statue appears again.
[ES] La estatua radiante aparece de nuevo.

[EN] The Cursed Statue appears again.
[ES] La estatua maldita aparece de nuevo.

[EN] First boss emits a stench.
[ES] El primer jefe emite un hedor.

[EN] Someone has been chained.
[ES] Alguien ha sido encadenado.

[EN] The combat area is now closed.
[ES] El área de combate ahora está cerrada.
